title: Blue Cloud Softech Launches BluEdge Sovereign AI Inference and Coforge Launches CXNova, an Agentic CX Orchestration Platform
description: Blue Cloud Softech and Coforge launch BluEdge and CXNova to improve sovereign AI deployment and deliver smarter, faster customer experiences.

title: OpenAI Faces Lawsuit Over Hacking Incident. Plaintiff Says 'AI Did It' Is Not A Defense.
description: The lawsuit argues that OpenAI is responsible for the actions of its AI agents.

title: BMW bets on cuts, new models and AI to revive its fortunes
description: BMW set out a restructuring plan on Wednesday centred on AI, management cuts and two new model launches as the German luxury automaker seeks to restore investor confidence after a string of profit warnings and a deep slump in its share price.
